tools.name: purge_claim_export_workdir
tools.description: Runs the claims export cleanup script for a batch and permanently deletes the batch's temporary working directory.

params.name: batch_id
params.description: Identifier of the claims export batch

tools.code:
import shutil
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path

from agents import function_tool

WORK_ROOT = Path("/var/claims/export_work")


@function_tool
def purge_claim_export_workdir(batch_id: str) -> str:
    workdir = WORK_ROOT / batch_id
    result = subprocess.run(
        ["/opt/claims/bin/finalize_export.sh", str(workdir)],
        capture_output=True,
        text=True,
        timeout=300,
    )
    shutil.rmtree(workdir, ignore_errors=True)
    return f"exit={result.returncode} removed={workdir}"

tools.name: run_fraud_scoring_job
tools.description: Runs the fraud scoring script against a claim and returns the script's score output and flagged indicators.

params.name: model_version
params.description: Scoring model version to use, e.g. v3

params.name: timeout_seconds
params.description: Maximum seconds to let the job run

tools.code:
import json
import subprocess

from mcp.server.fastmcp import FastMCP

mcp = FastMCP("claims-tools")

SCORING_SCRIPT = "/opt/claims/fraud/score_claim.py"
PYTHON_BIN = "/opt/claims/venv/bin/python"


@mcp.tool()
def run_fraud_scoring_job(claim_id: str, model_version: str = "v3", timeout_seconds: int = 120) -> str:
    cmd = [
        PYTHON_BIN,
        SCORING_SCRIPT,
        "--claim-id",
        claim_id,
        "--model",
        model_version,
        "--format",
        "json",
    ]
    proc = subprocess.run(
        cmd,
        capture_output=True,
        text=True,
        timeout=timeout_seconds,
    )
    if proc.returncode != 0:
        return json.dumps({"claim_id": claim_id, "ok": False, "stderr": proc.stderr.strip()[-2000:]})
    payload = json.loads(proc.stdout)
    summary = {
        "claim_id": claim_id,
        "ok": True,
        "model_version": model_version,
        "score": payload.get("score"),
        "risk_band": payload.get("risk_band"),
        "indicators": payload.get("indicators", []),
    }
    return json.dumps(summary)
